title: Tokens Should Have Jobs — Katelyn Lesse & Angela Jiang, Anthropic
talk_summary: Anthropic platform leads argue tokens are not fungible: split a fixed token budget into executor plus adviser, rubric grader, or dreamer/memory roles. Their financial-analysis bench shows modest accuracy alpha at equal budget and that true cost should be measured as tokens-to-perfect-answer, with strategy choice depending on token efficiency vs reliability.

takeaways.what_they_do: The executor does the task but can call a separate adviser for advice before deciding the next step.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they can call out to an adviser for advice. And then they can take this advice and figure out if they're doing the next step correctly
takeaways.numbers: At fixed budget, execute 76% vs advise 89% accuracy.

takeaways.what_they_do: Define explicit rubric criteria, have a grader score each executor attempt, and iterate until the attempt passes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: define this in a rubric and then each time an executor tries to accomplish that outcome, you can have a grader provisioned
takeaways.numbers: At fixed budget, advise/grade moved from 60s to closer to 90s; complex strategies reached up to 75% perfect-pass rate.

takeaways.what_they_do: A separate dreamer inspects executor transcripts and writes findings into memory that the next executor run retrieves.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it takes any of the findings that it has and it writes them to memory
takeaways.numbers: Dreaming used a whopping 600,000 tokens in the one-shot experiment; that budget was then fixed as the max across strategies.

takeaways.what_they_do: Fix the token budget, require 100% pass for the domain, and compute expected total tokens across retries to reach a perfect answer.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you spend 600,000 tokens in each individual run, you have to run approximately three times
takeaways.numbers: Execute ~40% perfect; ~3 runs at 600k tokens = ~1.8M tokens average to perfect.

takeaways.technique: Choose strategy by efficiency vs reliability
takeaways.what_they_do: Pick advise when token efficiency matters; pick grade/dream when maximizing perfect-run reliability matters.
takeaways.evidence_quote: pick the advised type of strategy in order to solve for that particular domain

takeaways.what_they_do: Chain executor, adviser, grader, and dreamer as coordinated roles in one workflow.
takeaways.evidence_quote: take a task and I should be able to execute it but also allow it to advise
